title: Reading and Writing CSV Files in Python
description: Learn how Python handles CSV files: read, write, and parse them with the built-in csv library, and see how pandas does the same job.
summary: Let’s face it: you need to get information into and out of your programs through more than just the keyboard and console . Exchanging information through text files is a common way to share info between programs.
